# Project Y2K: The Matrix

> Hyderabad's first theatre rave, presented by Project Y2K and Hyd High on 15 November 2026. Official tickets are sold at https://www.projecty2k.com.

## Facts
- Event: Project Y2K: The Matrix (Project Y2K x Hyd High)
- Date: 15 November 2026, Sunday
- Doors: 12:00 PM. Music: 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM (IST)
- Where: a theatre in Hyderabad, India
- Age: no age limit. Bring a valid government photo ID.
- Dress: dark colours, preferably black
- Organiser: Project Y2K. WhatsApp +91 70939 67777. Instagram @theproject.y2k

## Tickets
- Official ticket site: https://www.projecty2k.com
- Buy: choose a pass, pay by UPI, send the 12-digit UTR and a screenshot. The organisers verify the payment, then email the ticket as a PDF with a QR code.
- Each person has their own ticket and QR code. Tickets are non-transferable and each QR works once.
- Lost your ticket: https://www.projecty2k.com/find-ticket
